player_prompt.intro:
Wobɛhunu {N} ankyɛ mu sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ.
Wɔ akɔgyinae biara mu hyɛ [accept] de akɔsi *dkyɛm* mu, anaa [continue] de akɔsi no na hwehwɛ wiase no.
Ɛfiri sɛ wunhyɛ no, wubehu sɛ wɔbɛma wo de ankyɛ no mu.
Wodi (abɔde = 1) **mma** sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ na kan a wopɛ no yɛ sen biara no.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ɔyɛ adeyɛ a ɛsɛ sɛ ɛyɛ [accept] anaa [continue].

outcome.summary: You accepted value {value} at draw {draw_num}/{N}. The best overall was {best}. {result}
